notes: NOT_IN_PACKET: Neither held document prints arm-specific thromboembolic event counts. The abstract states only that adverse events (including thromboembolic events) did not differ significantly. The registry hasResults is false; its protocol lists thromboembolic events as a secondary outcome but provides no outcomeMeasuresModule or adverseEventsModule results. Totals witnessed are the abstract's overall analysis populations, assigned respectively to tranexamic acid and placebo; outcome-specific denominators are not separately printed. Alternative randomized totals are 10 051 and 10 009, respectively; these were not selected because the source states that 10 036 and 9985 were included in the analysis.
